failed_or_abandoned: Logistic regression of outcome on covariates abandoned: outcome is perfectly separated by prior_type (0/25 vs 4/5), coefficients diverge; stratified counts reported instead.
Parametric (Weibull) survival fit dropped for Kaplan-Meier: heavy censoring in the no-comparable-test stratum leaves the shape unconstrained.
Estimate of the number of never-written-up ~3 sigma excursions kept only as a bracket (x2-5 per recalled item); every input is a recalled guess.

First version of the pi_DM translation used np.interp, which clamps at P061's table edges (r = 0.02 and 0.20) and gave a spurious 68 % lower bound of exactly 0.0060 and a spurious threshold r = 0.200; replaced by a log-log fit (slope 1.08, reproduces the table to 3 %) with extrapolation.
First Fig. 3 plotted Jeffreys posterior densities, which spike at r = 0 and are unreadable; replaced by posterior CDFs on a log axis.

Items suggested in the assignment but not recalled with confidence and therefore not listed: XENON1T 'S2-only' excess, PICO/COUPP excesses, LUX/PandaX/XENON1T single high-energy events, EDELWEISS beyond the vague five-event item.
